cards.title: 体重趋势是测量序列，不等于身体储能或肌肉变化

limitations: 体重变化本身不能确认肌肉、脂肪、水分各自变化。
该研究的肥胖与体重管理情境不自动成为力量增肌用户的个体校准。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Introduction rejects static weight-loss arithmetic; quantitative physiology section differentiates fat/lean energy content and partitioning. Only the limitation is activated, no group parameter is assigned to an individual.
reviewed_claims.text: 这篇动态能量平衡研究说明体重变化涉及脂肪和瘦组织的不同分配，并批评忽略代谢适应的固定体重—热量换算。

cards.remaining_gate: Only the explicitly linked source-specific statement is reviewed; all other draft claims/formulas and personal action efficacy remain unapproved.

cards.title: 设备总能量是来源报告，不是真实总消耗

limitations: 没有从群体验证结果推算该用户的真实总消耗或绝对摄入。
没有固定设备误差带或热效应加成获得授权。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: The located Conclusions identify heterogeneity across target populations, processing/statistics and limited free-living validation. This supports a limitation statement only; no numerical device correction is inferred.
reviewed_claims.text: INTERLIVE 指南指出可穿戴能量消耗验证在人群、数据处理和统计方法上存在差异，且自由生活条件验证不足会限制对实际使用准确性的判断。

cards.title: Hall–Chow摄入变化与rho有效动力学参数
cards.remaining_gate: E2/E3/E4 free-to-read links are not OA grants; PMC frontmatter and Europe PMC both leave indexing rights unresolved. Exact equations/parameters not marked reviewed.

cards.title: 手表与体重不能单独识别真实摄入和设备偏差
cards.remaining_gate: Available E1 dynamic-model evidence does not by itself approve every structural identifiability claim in this draft. Additional E2/E3/E4 fulltext rights pending.

cards.title: 能量估计的误差传播必须包含基线、参数与模型条件

limitations: 没有从群体误差示例构造个人固定误差带。
Hall–Chow 相对摄入变化模型的原始论文与参数仍需独立获取和逐式审核。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: The modelling section directly identifies uncertainty in baseline energy needs as a fundamental limitation and shows propagation to predictions. Numeric uncertainty estimates from the study are not reused as a fixed personal error band.
reviewed_claims.text: 该动态体重模型指出，初始维持能量需求的不确定性会传播到个体体重轨迹预测；即使依从性理想，基线未知仍限制精确预测。

cards.title: 动作身份、负重口径与可比条件

limitations: 研究中的力竭测试与未挑战的计划工作组不同。
未审核原种子中的杆重、传动比和完整负荷换算主张；它们不能通过此卡自动获得科学效度。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Abstract and Conclusions explicitly distinguish leg-press and bench-press repetition relationships and quantify between-individual variation. Review approves only the exercise-specificity claim, not load-conversion formulas.
reviewed_claims.text: 这项次数与相对最大负荷的综合研究发现腿举和卧推的关系不同，并分别提供估计；不能仅凭相同配重或次数认定不同动作测量等价。

cards.title: 测量误差与有用变化是两个不同问题

limitations: 综述层面的误差范围不是该用户、该器械或当前动作的个体校准。
本文审核不授权从少数相同记录判断真实能力停滞。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Results report exercise-stratified CVs; main findings concern study-level test-retest reliability; limitations present nonzero limits of agreement. No universal personal error floor is imported.
reviewed_claims.text: 该重测综述报告了较好的最大力量测试可靠性，同时保留不同动作的变异和一致性界限；较高可靠性不能当作个人测量没有误差。

cards.title: 个人预测先与可比历史基线作时间外比较

limitations: 速滑研究不能证明本工具对力量训练个体已经有效。
本文没有验证 B1 必然胜过 B0，也没有确定个人干预因果效应。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: The time-series cross-validation methods explicitly state chronological splitting and prevention of future-to-past leakage. Conclusion requires model validation before predictive physiological interpretation. Scope remains methodology, not strength-user efficacy.
reviewed_claims.text: 这项精英短道速滑表现建模研究按时间划分训练与评估数据，并明确避免用未来信息预测过去；拟合优度不能替代未来预测验证。

cards.remaining_gate: M2 explicit publisher CC-BY version grant found but official XML retrieval returned 403; N1 fulltext rights/location still pending. Statistical research code is separately testable, not activated scientific advice.

cards.remaining_gate: N1/N2 identity metadata acquired; no authorized reviewed original method spans. Repeated-look research implementation must retain method assumptions and simulation-only scope.

cards.title: 进阶是条件性任务选择，不是唯一最优负重

limitations: 该研究不能直接外推到上肢、老年人、未训练者或精英运动员；研究作者明确列出这些限制。
没有任何个人下次公斤数或成功概率由此获得授权。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Methods/Participants and Procedures establish population, lower-body exercises and the two progression interventions; Conclusion explicitly identifies repetition progression as another option. This is a source-specific study summary, not proof of a personal optimal load.
reviewed_claims.text: 一项针对已受训年轻成人、下肢动作的短期研究把增加负荷和固定负荷增加次数作为两种进阶方案；其结果支持把次数进阶视为一种可选路径。

cards.title: SDNN协议身份与个人描述基线

limitations: 这不是 Apple 字段文档的替代；Apple 原文索引权限仍单独登记。
没有把 SDNN 换算为 RMSSD，也没有用其自动计算训练减量。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: The measurement section explicitly defines the two metrics separately and identifies recording duration/position/time as protocol requirements. No scalar conversion or personal training threshold is supported.
reviewed_claims.text: 这篇综述把 SDNN 与 RMSSD 列为不同的时域 HRV 指标，并强调记录时长、时间和测量方法要一致；不同设备的指标不能总是直接比较。

cards.title: sRPE负荷需要独立整体用力感与协议时长

limitations: 量表、翻译授权和采集延迟须分别核查；当前审核不复制量表图。
指标是任意单位的训练负荷描述，不能解释成机械功、肌肉刺激或恢复真值。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Rationale paragraphs distinguish session duration and retrospective whole-session intensity. Arithmetic examples support the named measure, but this review activates explanatory semantics only and never substitutes set-level scores.
reviewed_claims.text: session-RPE 方法要求训练者对整次训练进行回顾性用力评价，并结合整次训练时长；逐组用力评分的中位数不是这一整体回答。

reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Methods identify older women, RMSSD and trial design; Results state no significant group-by-time interaction; conclusion is confined to that comparison. A nonsignificant result is not proof of equivalence or universal ineffectiveness.

cards.title: 工作组与配重次数是记录统计，不是有效刺激真值

limitations: 不能把不同动作配重次数相加后称为机械功或精确肌肉刺激。
该来源按明确的非商业内部用途保存，不授权分发改编原文。
reviewed_claims.support_rationale: Discussion paragraphs explicitly distinguish set volume from volume load and state uncertainty around exact optimizing sets/RIR. This narrow summary does not quantify individual muscle stimulus from tonnage.
